title: THE UNDERCROFT WALLS SIT IN THE ROOM LIGHT
why: Seen on the 4K Undercroft screenshot of 2026-10-08: the walls of the Undercroft wore the raid daylight wall colours at full strength, so in the dark navy room the blue walls by the lift, the purple block by the shop and the green block by Settings glowed like lit panels. Each wall keeps its colour, taken about half way down into the room own light, so they read as walls in a dim room. A look change: tell me if you want them back.
now: The Undercroft walls are dimmed to suit the room; each keeps its colour.
